question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (4)** i.e. **‘explorer’.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Yet Wallace, who was an (5) ____, had been working far away in the Malay Archipelago, whilst Darwin had not left England for several years.
 
• From the passage, it is clear that Wallace was also researching the problem of species. He had been working far away in the Malay Archipelago. It means he was travelling here and there to collect the matter.
 
• **‘explorer’ (अन्वेषक)** - A person who explores an unfamiliar area; an adventurer.
 
• Hence, ‘explorer’ is the most appropriate to fill in the blank.

**Therefore, the correct sentence is **Darwin planned to (1) ***write ***__a book describing his (2) __***discoveries***__. He spent nearly twenty years (3) __***collecting***__ the matter for his book, which was to deal with every known fact concerning the problem of the species. Unluckily for Darwin, a naturalist named Wallace had been (4) __***thinking ***__over the same problems and had reached the same solution. He sent Darwin an essay which almost word for word repeated Darwin's own ideas. Yet Wallace, who was an (5) __***explorer ***__had been working far away in the Malay Archipelago, whilst Darwin had not left England for several years. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• For this particular question we can **eliminate the option (1) and (3)**, because the blank starts with an **‘an’**. After an **‘an’** there must be a vowel sound letter.
 
• **Creator : (निर्माता) **- A person or thing that brings something into existence, doesn’t fit the context. 
 
• **Artist : (कलाकार)** - A person who produces paintings or drawings as a profession or hobby, not relevant here.
 
• **Wanderer : (भटकने वाला)** - A person who travels aimlessly; a traveller, not suitable in this context.
